hub.name: FYAISA
hub.tagline: A community hub for sideloaded homebrew on Amazon's Vega OS Fire TV devices.
hub.description: A community hub for sideloaded homebrew on Amazon's Vega OS Fire TV devices.

apps.name: FYAISA
apps.summary: The FYAISA hub app itself. Update it from here.
apps.description: The FYAISA homebrew hub for Vega OS Fire TV devices. Browse, install and update homebrew apps from your couch. This is the hub app itself, listed so you can update it from within.
apps.author: FYAISA contributors

install.note: Prebuilt .vpkg is published on the FYAISA releases page. If no matching build exists, the host installer builds it from installer/ with the Vega SDK.

notes: The FYAISA hub app itself. Update it from here.
Requires Developer Mode on the Fire TV; not installable from the Amazon Appstore.

apps.name: Super Mario Bros
apps.summary: NES SMB emulator for Vega OS Fire TV Sticks (no ROM bundled). Downloads ROM from external source on first launch.
apps.description: Super Mario Bros NES emulator for Vega OS Fire TV Sticks. Runs in a WebView using jsnes. Downloads the Super Mario Bros ROM from an external source on first launch so no copyrighted ROM is bundled (legally clean). TV remote mapping: D-Pad, Menu=Start, Back=Select, Fast-forward=A, Play/Pause=B. No WebView browsing, d-pad navigable.
apps.author: FYAISA contributors

install.note: Prebuilt .vpkg is published on the FYAISA releases page. If no matching build exists, the host installer builds it from apps/smb with the Vega SDK.

notes: Super Mario Bros NES emulator (jsnes). Downloads the ROM from an external host on first launch (no ROM bundled).
Requires Developer Mode on the Fire TV; not installable from the Amazon Appstore.

apps.name: Cinevega
apps.summary: Movies and TV streaming with a native TV interface. TMDB metadata, VidSrc playback.
apps.description: Cinevega is a native React Native streaming app for Vega OS Fire TV Sticks. Browse trending, popular movies and TV shows with full TMDB metadata (posters, overviews, ratings), search, and play through VidSrc. No WebView browsing, no captchas, no sign-up. D-pad navigable interface designed for the couch.
apps.author: FYAISA contributors

install.note: Prebuilt .vpkg is published on the FYAISA releases page. If no matching build exists, the host installer builds it from apps/cinevega with the Vega SDK.

notes: Native React Native frontend with TMDB metadata and VidSrc playback.
Requires Developer Mode on the Fire TV; not installable from the Amazon Appstore.

apps.name: VegaTube
apps.summary: Ad-free, sponsor-free YouTube for Vega OS Fire TV Sticks.
apps.description: Runs the official YouTube for TVs web app (youtube.com/tv) in a Vega WebView and injects the TizenTube userscript at document start, giving ad blocking, SponsorBlock, DeArrow, speed controls and themes on devices that cannot run the Android APK. Formerly TizenTube Vega; VegaTube is the FYAISA example app, with hub updates built in.
apps.author: FYAISA contributors

install.note: Prebuilt .vpkg is published on the FYAISA releases page. If no matching build exists, the host installer builds it from apps/vegatube with the Vega SDK.

notes: Contains a vendored copy of the TizenTube userscript (GPL-3.0); upstream credits live in the repos.
The FYAISA example app: pair with your PC for the in-app update menu, or use `fyaisa update app.vegatube.main`.
Requires Developer Mode on the Fire TV; not installable from the Amazon Appstore.

apps.name: ElevSH Files
apps.summary: Browse your Fire TV's real filesystem with the D-pad, over ElevSH.
apps.description: The app itself is sandboxed, so it reaches the real device filesystem indirectly: every directory listing and file preview is a `vega device run-cmd` on your paired PC, sent through the bridge's allowlisted /vega endpoint (no shell on the PC, output capped, timeout enforced). Pair once, then browse /var, /data and the rest with the remote.
apps.author: AaronYTDev

install.note: Prebuilt .vpkg is published on the FYAISA releases page. If no matching build exists, the host installer builds it from apps/fileexplorer with the Vega SDK.

notes: Pairs with ElevSH like every FYAISA app; approve it in FYAISA → ElevSH or with `fyaisa approve <code>`.
Requires Developer Mode on the Fire TV; not installable from the Amazon Appstore.

apps.name: Google Snake
apps.summary: Google's snake arcade game in a TV app. Needs internet, no account.
apps.description: Google's snake_arcade doodle game from google.com in a Vega WebView: Google's board, art, speeds and trophies. The remote's arrows and OK go straight to the page, Back quits, Home exits. The game streams from Google, so the stick needs internet; no sign-in.
apps.author: AaronYTDev

install.note: Prebuilt .vpkg is published on the FYAISA releases page. If no matching build exists, the host installer builds it from apps/snake with the Vega SDK.

notes: No pairing needed — it never talks to your PC or the network.
Requires Developer Mode on the Fire TV; not installable from the Amazon Appstore.

apps.name: DOOM (Shareware)
apps.summary: id Software's DOOM Episode One, compiled to WebAssembly, running fully offline on your Fire TV.
apps.description: The original DOOM engine, built from doomgeneric with emscripten, rendered to a canvas inside a Vega WebView with id's shareware episode embedded in the package. The D-pad walks and turns, OK fires and selects, Back opens doors and switches, Home exits. Nothing is fetched after install: engine, game data and loader all ship in the app. No sound yet, and config or saves reset on exit.
apps.author: AaronYTDev

install.note: Prebuilt .vpkg is published on the FYAISA releases page. If no matching build exists, the host installer builds it from apps/doom with the Vega SDK.

notes: Runs offline: the engine, the shareware episode data and the loader are inside the app.
Silent for now, and config or saves do not survive leaving the app.
Requires Developer Mode on the Fire TV; not installable from the Amazon Appstore.
